title: RSNA Knee Meta Fold Checkpoints V2
subtitle: rgb01-preprocessing checkpoints from rsna-knee-meta-train
description: Five-fold DINOv2 ViT-S checkpoints trained by the private kernel tensorhydra/rsna-knee-meta-train on the RSNA knee abnormality detection competition, saved with preproc marker rgb01 (inputs float in [0,1]). V2 supersedes rsna-knee-meta-folds; the v1 dataset is frozen to pair with pre-fix infer kernels.
